replies.context_pt: Saylor: "Saying there's no reason to own Bitcoin because AI can hack a crypto app is like saying there's no reason to speak English because AI can hack a messaging app." (08:39 Fortaleza; às 08:58 ~854 likes / 165 replies / 70k views). Post novo, ângulo diferente dos 8/9 de 27/10: segurança do app ≠ segurança do ativo. Opção b puxa custódia onchain de leve (sem prometer segurança, sem advice). Urgência alta (janela fresca).

options.a: an app getting hacked is an app problem. the asset was never the app
options.b: app security and asset security are two different conversations. one gets patched, the other lives in keys you hold yourself
options.c: ai finding bugs in an app is a reason to audit the app, not to stop speaking the language
